How we vet
a car.

Every car we put in front of you goes through the same checks. If it does not pass, you do not see it.

01

Title & VIN history

Clean title, no hidden liens, and accident and odometer reports checked before anything else.

02

Independent inspection

A specialist who works for you, not the seller’s own shop.

03

Service records

Maintenance history reviewed line by line, with gaps called out.

04

Paint & body

Panel gaps and paint thickness checked for repairs the seller may not mention.

05

Drive & cold start

A proper drive, plus a cold start, because some problems only show up then.

06

Fair-price check

The asking price compared with recent comparable sales, so you know where you stand.

We only recommend cars we would buy ourselves, and we tell you about any interest we have in a deal.
